title: Part-Time / Gig Income Optimizer
description: For hybrid W-2 + 1099 workers. Computes marginal effective rate on gig income (income tax + SE tax net of IRC §164(f) deduction), quarterly estimated payment amounts and due dates, safe harbor thresholds, and optional net hourly rate analysis. Uses 2026 projected IRS brackets. Policy Mandate v2.0: gig_income_record.
data_vintage: IRS 2026 brackets (projected Rev. Proc. 2025-22); SE tax 15.3% (IRC §1401); SS wage base $176,100 (2025); IRS $1,000 quarterly trigger
regulatory_citations: IRC §1401 — Self-employment tax (15.3% on 92.35% of net SE income)
IRS Publication 505 — Tax Withholding and Estimated Tax
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-22 — 2026 inflation-adjusted tax parameters (projected)

mcp_tool_definition.name: optimize_gig_income_tax
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given W-2 salary, filing status, state rate, gig income, and business expenses, returns effective marginal rate on gig income, SE tax breakdown, quarterly payment amounts, and net after-tax income. Uses 2026 projected IRS brackets. Deterministic.
